sentences.text: The product note says that for individual borrowers on floating-rate loans for non-business purposes, no foreclosure charge applies.
The retail loan policy excerpt only defines “foreclosure” as pre-payment of the loan in full and does not state any foreclosure charge rule.

On the evidence provided, I cannot confirm that the retail loan policy and the product note agree on foreclosure charges, because the policy excerpt does not address the charge while the product note says no charge applies.
